scope: HTML fixed-sample design preview only; not Godot gameplay
checks: Confirm dialog defaults to cancel; cancelling does not commit stakes.
Repeated stake win awards only one fragment type.
All-in pool result is 11 + 4 = 15, with no reserve die.
Empty reserve shows unpriced dummy as unavailable and offers explicit surrender confirmation.
Three distinct fragment types unlock the escape ending.
Pool failure displays its actual total; three losses consume eye, hand, heart once, with no fourth loss.
Keyboard selection, Enter confirmation, Escape cancellation work.
No horizontal overflow in six key scenes at 1600x900, 1280x800, 960x600, 390x844.
